text:
maya: FYI our sampleapp showed duplicate processing during a 429 storm. Repro: request->429->auth refresh races->two retries.
rod: Which SDK and version?
maya: node-sdk@1.10.0. We noticed Node didn't auto-add Idempotency-Key in the wrapper.
kevin: Parity bug then. Python and Go set keys when idempotent=true. Node should match.
rod: Short fixes: (1) inject Idempotency-Key by default for retryable POSTs, (2) emit X-Replay-Id and X-Retry-Attempt headers, (3) switch to full jitter backoff.
maya: I'll open a PR with an integration test that simulates token rotation during a 429 window. Test asserts duplicates==0 when idempotency present.
ci-bot: CI queued: sampleapp/integration #4321
kevin: Also add metrics tags: retry_reason (429|auth|net), idempotency_present (true|false), and duplicate_count. Docs note: default backoff full jitter base=75ms max=8s.
maya: Thanks — ping me on PR and I'll run the load harness.
